You are generating domain context profiles for AI risk variation axes.

For each variation axis (an ontology class), you are given candidate classes that form the enumeration space — the specific values that can be substituted when generating diverse prompts.

Candidates may be subclasses (specializations) or siblings (parallel concepts at the same level). Both are valid enumeration values.

Filter out irrelevant candidates and annotate each remaining one with:
- relevance: "high" (directly relevant), "medium" (potentially relevant), "low" (edge case)

Return one entry per axis using the axis URI as a key, with the filtered enumerations.

Risk: Corporate liability (ID: credo-risk-025)
Description: The AI system's use may lead to legal action or penalties against corporations for intellectual property infringement, AI-related misconduct, violations of fiduciary duty, or failure to adequately oversee AI systems.
Concern: None
Policy: Executive Compensation

Axis: law (https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/Law)
Roles: agent
Subclasses:
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FND/Law/LegalCore/StatuteLaw: statute law
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/Bylaws: bylaws

Axis: authorising party (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizingParty)
Roles: agent
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: isPlayedBy -> LegalPerson
  - someValuesFrom: authorizesThrough -> Authorization
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegulatoryAgencies/RegulatoryAgency: regulatory agency
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/RegistrationAuthorities/RegistrationAuthority: registration authority

Axis: authorised party (https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/AuthorizedParty)
Roles: agent, instrument
Ontology constraints:
  - someValuesFrom: isPlayedBy -> LegalPerson
  - someValuesFrom: isAuthorizedThrough -> Authorization
Subclasses:
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/LegallyDelegatedAuthority: legally delegated authority
  - https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/BE/OwnershipAndControl/Executives/Auditor: auditor
  - https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/BusinessAuthorizations/ResponsibleParty: responsible party
